provenance.method: Actual pinned original bootstrap plus direct JDK 21 javap; not REA MCP or a Main enchantment flow.

scope: Complete pinned original item registry enchantment values and declaring-owner rules. Default/count-one observations are not static predicates for arbitrary stacks. Unknown items, owners, component semantics or changed registry profiles require explicit unsupported handling.

observations.prototype_count_one_construction: new ItemStack(actualItem, 1), using the original item prototype
observations.actual_default_instance: Actual item.getDefaultInstance independently queried; only the listed gate observations are compared, not whole-stack component equality.
observations.air: The requested count-one AIR stack is empty and exposes effective count0/empty components.

dynamic_stack_gate.empty_stack: EMPTY singleton, AIR item or raw count<=0: effective item AIR, effective count0 and empty component/prototype maps; gate false.

predicates.default_max_stack_one_and_max_damage_pre: Effective getMaxStackSize()==1 AND effective MAX_DAMAGE exists. getMaxStackSize uses source default1 only when that component is absent.
predicates.count_one: Actual effective stack count==1; BookItem override.
predicates.never: Original AnimalArmorItem or EnchantedBookItem override returns false.

dynamic_stack_gate.after_item_predicate: Normal ENCHANTMENTS must be present and its actual levels map must be empty. Missing normal ENCHANTMENTS is false.
